name: @domio/sessionization
description: Phase 17 W4 — Sessionization engine. Reads events from Kafka topic events.ingest.raw (one consumer per partition keyed by workspace_id:viewer_id_key), groups them into sessions with a 30-min inactivity rule + 4-h max-duration cap, writes to Postgres session + ClickHouse sessions_long, and emits session.started/heartbeat/ended to NATS subject analytics.session.*.
